finding: Women with Müllerian anomalies are at an increased risk for multiple adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preterm delivery and intrauterine growth restriction, but perinatal mortality is not increased when controlled for gestational age and weight.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly higher in women with Müllerian anomalies (adjusted odds ratio, 13.4; 95% confidence interval, 11.5-15.6; p < .001).
